title: C4OS Grill Question 006 - User Config Location
notes_or_corrections: You can decide this. Follow industry standard for app config per user location depending on OS. Somewhat related: In the current MVP it puts project level config in `.c4os` folder in the project root, I didnt want to pollute project folders with an app hidden folder. I wanted it all in a config per user folder instead.

schema.title: C4OS Grill Question 006 - User Config Location

questions.label: Where should C4OS user-global config live?
questions.help: Recommended: literal home-level ~/.c4os on macOS/Linux, and an equivalent user-profile .c4os directory on Windows. This matches the original task list and keeps plugin/project/workspace config manually inspectable.
options: Hybrid: platform-native by default with ~/.c4os compatibility/export

questions.label: For Windows, what should the equivalent be?
questions.help: Recommended: %USERPROFILE%\.c4os for symmetry with ~/.c4os, unless platform convention matters more than manual inspectability.

questions.label: Notes or corrections
questions.help: Clarify whether secrets are excluded, whether workspace/project registries live here, and whether workspace descriptor files still exist separately.
